Game Overview

In Redhead Knight, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a vibrant journey with Arthur, the red-haired knight, in Redhead Knight. Navigate dynamic 2D worlds, dodge traps, and combat foes in escalating challenges. Master timing and strategy across 15 levels, collecting powerful upgrades and observing enemy patterns to outwit opponents and save your village.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Redhead Knight is easy to pick up. Embark on a vibrant journey with Arthur, the red-haired knight, in Redhead Knight.
